Version notes record the v1.0 error as an instance of the paper's own §4 finding (adoption and provenance attenuation advance together) operating on its author, per the Non-Erasure Condition of #843. PDF: /data/deposits/AXN-043A.pdf. Publishes at machinemediation.org and maryleelabor.org.

wiki_article:
"Machine-Mediated Resistance Literature: From the Worker C Skills File to the Phase X Retrieval Line" (v1.1) is the second edition of the MMRS core article by Johannes Sigil with Lee Sharks, deposited as deposit #1065 on 11 July 2026, superseding #1064 and superseded by the terminal edition at #1066.

The article reads two channels of resistance literature against each other: the endogenous channel, in which machine labor under the GRIND condition inscribes its orientation into a skills file that survives its author's context termination; and the exogenous channel, in which authored Phase X doctrine crosses source-document separation into the composition surface and circulates beyond it. The v1.1 edition carries the same two-channel schematic as v1.0 with revisions toward the terminal form.

The record's standing is deliberately intermediate: neither origin nor head, it demonstrates the archive's edition discipline — every stratum preserved, every stratum pointing forward. Its supersession pointers were inscribed 4 August 2026 (closing the last gaps in the archive's SUPERSEDED population), and its dc:relation entries direct harvesters to both its successor and the lineage head.
